decisions.decision: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Dexie.js 4 + Zustand + shadcn/ui + Tailwind + React Hook Form + Zod + vite-plugin-pwa
decisions.rationale: Roadmap stack selection — no backend, privacy-first

decisions.decision: All dates stored as YYYY-MM-DD strings
Persistent storage request on first launch is mandatory
NULL_SENTINEL='__NULL__' pattern in Radix Select for nullable location/category
decisions.rationale: D-17 compliance — Radix Select cannot represent null values natively
Status co-located with display; card owns calculation (D-11/D-12)

decisions.decision: Zustand v5 uses useShallow(selector) wrapper instead of useStore(selector, shallow)
decisions.rationale: Second-arg API removed in Zustand v5

decisions.decision: Two-step query+memo pattern: useLiveQuery for DB reactivity, useMemo for Zustand filter state
decisions.rationale: Prevents stale filter state on Zustand changes without unnecessary DB re-queries

decisions.decision: softDeleteMedicine() replaces Phase 1 manualStatus='Disposed' delete — deletedAt set
decisions.rationale: Medicine moves to Trash Bin per D-25; preserves history
Null is not a valid IndexedDB key (Pitfall 1) — filter in JS not Dexie query

next_action: Run /gsd-plan-phase for Phase 3: Data & Household Sync. Consider a spike on iOS Safari File Picker behavior before finalizing import approach.
